title: Built-In and Common Middleware knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which topic is explicitly listed in the syllabus coverage for “Built-In and Common Middleware”?
questions.explanation: The attached FastAPI syllabus lists “CORS middleware” under this lesson. The remaining syllabus subtopics are preserved in the lesson file for complete coverage.

questions.prompt: According to the worked example in “Built-In and Common Middleware”, which result should the learner verify?
options: Browser requests from the listed development origin can pass the configured CORS policy for the allowed methods/headers.
The app publishes itself to production and passes all tests automatically.
HTTP 500 is returned for every valid request.
Input validation and authorization are disabled by design.
questions.answer_key: Browser requests from the listed development origin can pass the configured CORS policy for the allowed methods/headers.
questions.explanation: The worked example explicitly documents this expected result. Reproduce it locally in the listed environment before treating it as tested behavior.

questions.prompt: Which CORS/middleware setup is appropriate? (Built-In and Common Middleware)
options: Allow only intended origins/methods/headers and test the middleware behavior
Use wildcard origins with credentialed browser requests without reviewing policy
Log authorization headers to debug every request
questions.answer_key: Allow only intended origins/methods/headers and test the middleware behavior
questions.explanation: CORS is a browser access policy, not authentication; credentialed requests require explicit origin policy.
